id: title:frankh:scale the logs sql editor read limit by plan tier

review.posthog_relevance: Allows paid and enterprise customers to read larger HogQL query results on log tables, while free tier remains at 50GB.
review.reason: Adds tier-dependent HogQL query byte limits for log tables, distinguishing free, paid, and enterprise tiers. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the tier-dependent feature flag or the backend service that checks the plan tier and returns the corresponding feature.
